annotations.title: Get comparable rentals near a Redfin property

description: Find nearby rental comparables for a given property: nearby active rental listings with similar bed/bath/sqft, including monthly rent, distance, and the Redfin URL. Useful for estimating what a property could rent for, or for finding rentals near a home you're considering. Inputs are the rent estimate range + lat/lng + propertyId — typically taken from the upstream `redfin_get_property` (or read from the property page directly).

rent_estimate_high.description: Upper bound of the rent estimate.

rent_estimate_low.description: Lower bound of the rent estimate. Use the same value for low+high if you only have one estimate.

name: redfin_get_comparable_rentals
title: Get comparable rentals near a Redfin property
